**Kamrul Hasan**
Assistant Professor, Department of Information Sciences and Technologies, College of Computing, Grand Valley State University, Allendale, MI 49401
hasanka@gvsu.edu · [Google Scholar](https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=uY57PPoAAAAJ&hl=en) · [GitHub](https://github.com/mdkamrulhasan)

## Research Profile

AI/ML researcher with 15+ years of academic and industry experience in machine learning, deep learning, generative AI, data mining, and multimodal learning. Current research focuses on AI-driven solutions for precision agriculture, environmental monitoring, healthcare, and other data-intensive applications, building on extensive experience solving real-world problems in academia and industry. Scholarly contributions include 20+ peer-reviewed journal and conference articles, a U.S. provisional patent, competitive research funding, and peer-review service for leading AI/ML conferences and journals.

**Research interests:** Generative AI · Deep Learning · NLP · Computer Vision · Precision Agriculture · Environmental Monitoring · Healthcare AI · Data Mining

## Industry and Research Experience

**Principal Data Scientist**, IVADO Labs, Montréal, QC · Nov 2018 – Aug 2023
Led interdisciplinary teams of scientists and engineers on applied AI projects:

- Aircraft predictive maintenance (condition monitoring, diagnostics, prognostics).
- Airline booking demand forecasting, no-show prediction, and revenue optimization.
- Critical cargo identification in busy seaports during COVID-19 using NLP.
- In-canopy temperature prediction for precision farming.

**Data Mining Researcher**, JDA Software (now Blue Yonder), Scottsdale, AZ · Jan 2015 – Sep 2018
Core contributor to AI integration in supply-chain solutions:

- Cognitive Demand: Deep RNN model for demand forecasting.
- Preference-oriented customer segmentation and intelligent store clustering.
- Out-of-stock detection on retail shelves via computer vision.
- Fashion trend prediction through social media signal analysis.

**Postdoctoral Fellow** (Mitacs Elevate Award), École Polytechnique, Université de Montréal, QC · Aug 2014 – Dec 2014
Applied CNNs and deep learning to automate out-of-stock and share-of-shelf detection on retail store shelves.

**Ph.D. Research Assistant**, École Polytechnique, Université de Montréal, QC · Sep 2009 – Jul 2014
Developed advanced probabilistic models (Bayesian and Markov network-based) for high-dimensional data; designed a probabilistic smoothed zero-one loss binary classifier outperforming Logistic Regression and SVM baselines.

**Research Associate**, Institute of Information Science, Academia Sinica, Taipei, Taiwan · Sep 2005 – Jun 2007
Extended ISLE/MILE lexical standards from European to Asian languages (Mandarin, Taiwanese, Cantonese, Bangla, Malay) as part of a multilingual NLP group.

## Student Mentorship and Research Supervision

Since joining Grand Valley State University in 2023, I have supervised undergraduate and graduate research projects spanning machine learning and AI, data science, software engineering, healthcare, cybersecurity, and precision agriculture, several of which have led to scholarly publications and ongoing collaborations.

- **Undergraduate mentorship:** Supervised four undergraduate capstone students and currently supervise one undergraduate research assistant on an MSGC-funded project mapping urban heat islands and environmental inequity in West Michigan.
- **Current thesis supervision:** Supervise three graduate thesis students in CIS 695 working on Graph RAG models, obesity analytics for Michigan residents, and time-series deep learning models.
- **CIS 692, Master's Capstone:** Co-instructed and supervised four students in two industry-oriented teams developing a Google Earth Engine-based GIS and a deep learning system for colonoscopy polyp detection.
- **CIS 691, PSM Internship Supervision:** Supervised five PSM interns on research-oriented projects in healthcare and precision agriculture, including dental implant failure prediction, precision agriculture sensor networks, and deep learning for skin disease detection. One project received the Best Project Award at the College of Computing Innovation Day (Health Informatics, Winter 2025).
- **CIS 693, Master's Projects:** Supervised 14 Master's projects across software engineering, data science, machine learning, generative AI, precision agriculture, retail forecasting, and AI safety. One project received the Best Project Award at the College of Computing Innovation Day (Applied Computer Science, Winter 2026).
